content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have revealed several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new HomePod mini, security cameras, a next-generation Siri Remote for use with the new Apple TV 4K, and the highly anticipated HomePad product.

After digging into the code, it also appears to offer several important clues about the HomePad's specifications...

Engadget's Filipe Espósito found that, while the HomePad will likely run a variant version of tvOS, it may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather interesting privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information in widgets when it detects your iPhone nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions, one with a speaker base that may resemble a HomePod, and another designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple Home products I mentioned above, other unknown devices were also mentioned. I sincerely hope these include a smart doorbell. Are there any Apple Home products you're particularly excited about? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
